title: Kitten with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='fur' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcf8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e88a2e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='eyeGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#8ff5ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1fa8c9'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M28 38 L22 14 L44 26 Z' fill='#e88a2e'/>
  <path d='M72 38 L78 14 L56 26 Z' fill='#e88a2e'/>
  <path d='M30 34 L26 21 L41 28 Z' fill='#ffb3c7'/>
  <path d='M70 34 L74 21 L59 28 Z' fill='#ffb3c7'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='30' ry='27' fill='url(#fur)'/>

  <!-- forehead stripes -->
  <path d='M44 28 L46 36 L48 28 Z' fill='#c96f1c'/>
  <path d='M52 28 L54 36 L56 28 Z' fill='#c96f1c'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='50' rx='8.5' ry='9.5' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='50' rx='8.5' ry='9.5' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='52' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#0e6f8c'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='52' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#0e6f8c'/>

  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='47' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='47' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='54' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='54' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M44 46 l1.6 1.6 l-1.6 1.6 l-1.6 -1.6 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M66 46 l1.6 1.6 l-1.6 1.6 l-1.6 -1.6 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 59 L53 59 L50 62.5 Z' fill='#ff7fa3'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 62.5 Q46 67 42.5 64' fill='none' stroke='#c96f1c' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 62.5 Q54 67 57.5 64' fill='none' stroke='#c96f1c' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ffa8c0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ffa8c0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M22 55 L34 57' stroke='#fff3cf' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M21 61 L34 61' stroke='#fff3cf' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 55 L66 57' stroke='#fff3cf' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M79 61 L66 61' stroke='#fff3cf' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='23' ry='15' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#fff0d6'/>

  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#fff0d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#fff0d6'/>
</svg>
